title: Market Chatter: Microsoft Considers Legal Action Against Amazon, OpenAI Over Possible Breach of Exclusivity Deal
title_zh: 市场热议：微软考虑对亚马逊和 OpenAI 采取法律行动，因为它们可能违反排他性协议
summary: Microsoft (MSFT) is mulling legal action against Amazon (AMZN) and OpenAI over a $50 billion contrac
summary_zh: 微软 (MSFT) 正在考虑针对亚马逊 (AMZN) 和 OpenAI 价值 500 亿美元的合同采取法律行动

title: Oracle's "Halo Effect" Is the Real Deal. But is the AI Growth Stock a Buy in March?
title_zh: 甲骨文的“光环效应”是实实在在的。但人工智能成长股在三月份值得买入吗？
summary: Down big off its high, the sell-off in Oracle could be a buying opportunity for risk-tolerant investors.
summary_zh: 甲骨文的抛售从高点大幅下跌，对于承受风险的投资者来说可能是一个买入机会。

title: Microsoft considers legal action over $50 billion Amazon-OpenAI cloud deal, FT reports
title_zh: 据英国《金融时报》报道，微软考虑对价值 500 亿美元的亚马逊与 OpenAI 云交易采取法律行动
summary: Microsoft is considering legal action against its partner OpenAI and Amazon over a $50 billion deal that could violate its exclusive cloud ‌agreement with the ChatGPT maker, the Financial Times reported on Wednesday.
summary_zh: 据英国《金融时报》周三报道，微软正在考虑就一项 500 亿美元的交易对其合作伙伴 OpenAI 和亚马逊采取法律行动，该交易可能违反其与 ChatGPT 制造商的独家云协议。

title: Microsoft weighs legal action over $50bn Amazon-OpenAI cloud deal

title: Apple’s MotionVFX Deal Deepens Creator Studio And Services Ecosystem
title_zh: Apple 的 MotionVFX 交易深化了创作者工作室和服务生态系统
summary: Apple has acquired MotionVFX, a developer of plug ins and tools for Final Cut Pro, in a move to deepen its creative software offering. The deal is aimed at building out the Creator Studio bundle and reinforcing Apple's position with professional content creators.
summary_zh: Apple 收购了 Final Cut Pro 插件和工具开发商 MotionVFX，以深化其创意软件产品。该交易旨在打造 Creator Studio 捆绑包并巩固苹果在专业内容创作者中的地位。
